sources.title: Qwen3-Reranker — vllm-ascend
sources.snippet: The Qwen3 Reranker model series is the latest proprietary model of the Qwen family, specifically designed for text embedding and ranking tasks. Building upon the dense foundational models of the Qwen3 series, it provides a comprehensive range of text embeddings and reranking models in various sizes (0.6B, 4B, and 8B).

sources.snippet: Qwen3-Reranker-.6B Qwen3-Reranker-.6B is a lightweight text reranking model (595M parameters) from Alibaba's Qwen team, designed to score and reorder candidate documents for relevance to a query. It handles 32k-token contexts, supports 100+ languages, and accepts custom task instructions.
